title: Identification of tolerogenic dendritic cells-related prognostic biomarkers in Wilms tumor via machine learning integration
summary: The study uses TCGA tumor/normal specimens and GEO TolDC datasets, Boruta/SVM-RFE and Cox modeling; ALDH1A1, CXCR4 and FOSL2 are reported. No separate external validation or functional experiment is reported. The publisher lists 2026/12; the first version reporting this result is dated 2026-04-30.
